study: RWC-OPT (2026-10-08, frozen before RW-C's first minute): live-prep's Phase A simulator with TB1's tight-touch option, a 65-arm search on RW's record 2026-09-25 00:00 -> 10-08 23:10 UTC (both fill models, R 1 / 0.4 / 0.2, walk-forward and a reality check), and the frozen arms C1 (S2 + TB1 skip), C2 (exits, reported) and C3 (x1 + pause + TB1 skip), read on RW-C's record 10-09 -> 10-23 after 10-23 00:05 UTC

inputs.data/rw_min_YYYY-MM-DD.json.gz: RW's stored minutes of 2026-10-04 -> 10-08 (10-08 to 23:10 UTC), sql/pull_minutes.sql on pm_rw_minutes through the Supabase connector, read-only, 2026-10-08 22:5x-23:13 UTC; 09-25 -> 10-03 are live-prep's committed ../pmlp/data/min_*.json.gz
inputs.data/rw_record.json.gz: RW's selections, settlements, day rows, prints and fills, sql/pull_record.sql on pm_rw (plus the replays' day rows), read-only, 2026-10-08 23:13 UTC
inputs.data/rwc_*: not here: RW-C's record, pulled by the same statements on pm_rwc after 2026-10-23 00:05 UTC

run: cd docs/agents/backtests/rwc_opt  # every script reads data/ and results/ relative to this folder, and .json.gz when the .json is absent
npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --no-check scripts/check.ts rw > results/rw_check.txt  # the simulator reproduces pm_rw_days
npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --allow-write --no-check scripts/run.ts rw  # results/rw_arms.json
python3 -I scripts/bar.py results/rw_arms.json > results/rw_bar.txt  # the bar's code on RW's record, in sample
npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --allow-write --no-check scripts/grid.ts [--at-price]  # results/rw_grid[_atprice].json, the search
python3 -I scripts/analyse.py results/rw_grid.json 0.4 6 > results/rw_grid_r04.txt  # and 1.0, 0.2; results/rw_grid_atprice.json 0.4 6
at the reading: pull RW-C with sql/*.sql (pm_rwc), scripts/grab*.py into data/rwc_*, then check.ts rwc, run.ts rwc, bar.py results/rwc_arms.json
